plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period parchment, an inked 4-step actomyosin cross-bridge ATPase cycle diagram (from Hugh Huxley 1969 Science 164: 1356–1365 & Lymn and Taylor 1971 Biochemistry 10: 4617–4624) shows ATP binding (detachment from rigor), ATP hydrolysis to ADP + Pi (cocking the myosin lever arm), actin re-attachment, and phosphate release driving a ~5–10 nanometre, ~4 piconewton power stroke.
